narration: Eighty percent of medical bills have at least one error inside. The average mistake? Thirteen hundred dollars. And almost nobody ever catches it.
visual: Dark background. Hospital building SVG springs in. Animated counter climbs from 0 to 80%. Red '$1,300 AVG MISTAKE' badge fades in at bottom.

narration: Here's why — hospitals don't send itemized bills by default. They send a summary that says 'Medical Services: $7,030.' That's it. No breakdown. No detail. Just trust us.
visual: Light background. A bill document slides in showing one single line: 'Medical Services Rendered... $7,030.' Labels appear calling out the missing itemization.

narration: The three most common errors: duplicate charges, where they bill twice for one test. Upcoding, where they charge for a more expensive procedure. And ghost charges — items that were never actually used on you.
visual: Dark background. Three error cards spring in one by one: stacked-document icon for duplicate charge, upward-arrow icon for upcoding, crossed-out document icon for ghost charge.

narration: Here's the thing — you have a legal right to an itemized bill. Call the billing department and say five words: 'Send me an itemized bill.' They're required to send it. Federal law.
visual: Light background. Phone SVG springs in. Speech bubble appears: 'SEND ME AN ITEMIZED BILL.' Legal instruction text fades in below.

narration: Then compare it line by line to your Explanation of Benefits from your insurer. Any mismatch you find — call and dispute it. Hospitals quietly resolve most of these without a fight.
visual: Dark background. Two panel documents side by side: EOB showing 'Lab Test: $320' versus Hospital Bill showing 'Lab Test: $640' with a pulsing red highlight on the mismatch.

narration: There's an eighty percent chance your last medical bill had an error. One phone call, five words, fifteen minutes — and thirteen hundred dollars could be back in your pocket. Go check it.
visual: Light background. Piggy bank SVG scales in with a coin falling into the slot. CTA text: 'CALL BILLING. SAY: SEND ME AN ITEMIZED BILL.' Red badge: '$1,300 BACK IN YOUR POCKET'.
